title: Senior Full-Stack Node.js Developer
jobDescription: Job Description Responsibilities As a Senior Full-Stack Node.js Developer , you will play a key role in the ongoing development of our innovative software solution for modern warehouse and shipping management. • Development of high-quality software solutions using Node.js, Express, Java Script, Type Script, Sequelize/My SQL, React. • Actively shaping the software architecture and contributing to technical design decisions. • Development, testing, and documentation of new features. • Collaboration within a small, self-organized Scrum team. • Documentation of planning, development, and implementation processes in Jira and Confluence. Desired Candidate Profile • Several years of professional experience as a Node.js Backend Developer. • Very good knowledge of Express and React. • Solid knowledge of Java Script and Type Script. • Solid understanding of software architecture and backend design principles. • In-depth knowledge of Sequelize/My SQL, including SQL optimization and performance optimization of database queries. • Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and message queues (AWS SQS or Rabbit MQ). • Very good English language skills. Nice to have: • Experience with automated testing (e.g. Jest) and building test coverage in existing codebases. • Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. • Experience with inventory management or logistics systems. • Experience with AI-assisted development tools. Back

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Python , React , Vite)
jobDescription: Job Description Responsibilities Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to design, build, and scale high-performance web applications. You will own both backend services and frontend experiences, collaborating closely with the product team in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment. The ideal candidate is proactive, self-driven, and comfortable working with modern tooling and AI-assisted development workflows. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and Fast API. Build responsive, high-quality user interfaces with React, Vite, and Type Script. Integrate frontend and backend layers to deliver seamless end-to-end functionality. Design and optimize relational data models using Postgre SQL and SQLAlchemy. Implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms. Write unit and integration tests to maintain software quality and reliability. Participate in CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment processes. Deliver clean, maintainable, and well-documented code independently within tight timelines. Desired Candidate Profile 4+ years of professional experience in web application development. Strong proficiency in Pytho nwith hands-on experience using Fast API. Solid experience with Postgre SQL, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic for data modeling and validation. Frontend expertise in React, Vite, and Type Script. Proficiency with Docker, containerization, and modern CI/CD practices. Strong command of Git and version control workflows. Experience with pytest or equivalent testing frameworks. Solid understanding of authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, etc.). Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code preferred)and strong prompt engineering practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Nice to Have Experience in logistics or domain-driven software systems. Knowledge of AI/ML, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Generative AI. Exposure to cloud platforms and web application deployment (AWS, GCP, or Azure). What We Value Clean, readable code with clear documentation. Ownership mentality — you take tasks from inception to production. Adaptability and a genuine curiosity for new tools and technologies. Clear communication and a collaborative working style. Back

title: Hardware Development Engineer / Electronic Engineer – Design & Layout
jobDescription: Job Description Responsibilities We are seeking an experienced Hardware Development Engineer / Electronic Engineer – Design and Layout to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in electronics development, power electronics design, and PCB layout, with hands-on experience in circuit design, simulation, and component selection. Experience in electromobility applications will be an added advantage. Key Responsibilities • Create and develop circuit diagrams for electronic hardware designs. • Design and implement layouts for power electronics applications. • Create and maintain electronic components in the component database. • Perform simulations, calculations of circuit elements, and worst-case analyses to ensure robust design performance. • Identify and qualify second-source components to support supply chain reliability and component availability. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle. • Ensure designs meet performance, quality, manufacturability, and safety requirements. Desired Candidate Profile • Strong experience in electronics development. • Expertise in power PCB layout, including: o Power loop layout o Current sensing o Isolation safety o EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) o Thermal design o Assembly risk assessment o Design for Manufacturing (DFM) • Good knowledge of SMD electronic components. • Proficiency in Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB design. • Ability to perform circuit simulations, calculations, and design validation activities. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. • Experience in electromobility projects, products, or systems is highly preferred. What We Are Looking For • Detail-oriented engineering professional with a strong understanding of hardware design principles. • Ability to independently manage design and layout activities from concept to production. • Commitment to delivering high-quality, reliable, and manufacturable electronic designs. Back

title: Senior Frontend Developer (Angular, TypeScript, SCSS)
jobDescription: Job Description Responsibilities You are responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of our existing frontend applications. You will ensure that our user interfaces are modern, performant, and user-friendly. You will work closely with UX/UI designers, backend colleagues, and other stakeholders, contributing your expertise to actively advance our frontend architecture, toolchains, and development processes. • Design and implementation of modern web applications for controlling and monitoring industrial machinery and equipment • Active participation in an agile software development process in close collaboration with backend developers, UI/UX designers, and related departments • Planning and implementation of web-based projects, APIs, and web services, as well as ensuring their quality and performance through regular code reviews and testing • Contributing to the design and optimization of existing user interfaces (UI/UX) • Providing second-level support for our global external and internal customer base Organizational Structure : This position is within the Software Engineering department and reports directly to the Head of Application Engineering. Team Size : You will work in a growing team of currently 12 developers. The mix of specialized frontend and backend experts, as well as full-stack AI specialists, provides you with a strong professional environment characterized by extensive collaboration and mutual support. International Connections: Due to our company's global reach, you will regularly interact with international locations, particularly with our teams in Europe and beyond. Many projects are carried out in intercultural, cross-location teams. Desired Candidate Profile • Relevant experience as a Frontend Developer (m/f/d). • Strong expertise in the design and implementation of modern SPAs with Angular, Type Script and SCSS. • Understanding of RESTful APIs and their integration into frontend applications. • Basic knowledge of C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Azure is desirable. • Enjoyment of conceptual work and enthusiasm for innovative technologies in mechanical and plant engineering. Back
